answer: The reveal must open the same ocean hash, and a reveal that arrives late or mismatched is dropped at the violet gate. Copying becomes a race the attacker always loses, and producing 20 original texts is the only way to fill 28 aliases; the inlet log preserves both halves. Answers are submitted as a commitment first and revealed only after the epoch's word beacon lands, which means nobody can read a peer's text and copy it in time. That is 38 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
